|Short, nimble bug who uses barbed bolas to keep beasts corralled and caged.<hr/>Their throwing weapon is well-suited to the wide caverns they inhabit. These sly little bugs must have a keen claw for crafting.

<b>Roachcatchers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are round, flying [[Roach Tenders]] in tattered hoods, wielding spiked bolas.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Roachcatchers fly in a small area when idle, but pursue Hornet through the air after spotting her.<br>
Being ranged flying enemies, they constantly attempt to keep distance between themselves and Hornet, but mainly horizontally distance themselves.
To attack, they whirl a shuriken-like bola around before throwing it at Hornet. If it hits the ground, the bola splits in two and bounces, staying on the ground as a hazard before despawning after a few seconds. They can be knocked away and destroyed by Hornet's attacks.

Hornet can deflect the bolas with her attacks, sometimes hitting the Roachcatcher with their own shurikens, dealing 5 damage. Deflected bolas do not leave environmental hazards after landing on a surface.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Roachcatchers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Poke them, slash them...
* Teach them fear...
* Locks tight...
* Sharp jaws, and teeth...
}}

== Location ==
Roachcatchers can be found primarily in [[Sinner's Road]]. They also appear in [[Greymoor]].

The rightmost one in Sinner's Road only spawns when Hornet is spotted by the nearby [[Roachfeeder]].
